name: arth-workspace
description: Workspace scripts for Arth frontend and backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:backend: node --check backend/server.js && node --check backend/services/ragService.js && node --check backend/services/newsService.js
